book.name: Naꞌ Markus
book.title: Aꞌan Alekot matoom neu Usif Jesus, natuin Naꞌ Markus in sulat

content: Usif Jesus naleko atoni amaunut leꞌut es leꞌ pah-tuaf namfau antaam mbi in nekan
Nalali te, Jesus nok In asium-noinaꞌ sin ntenuk nifu ꞌnaek Galilea in panin, mbi baal jes, kanan Garasa.

Mbi nane, nmuiꞌ tuaf es, leꞌ pah-tuaf amaunut antaam mbi in nekan, tal antee namaunuꞌ leuꞌ. In nabala mbi niut nateꞌ. Nenoꞌ-fai in paililbah napuun-nateef mbi ꞌnuꞌaf-aꞌnuꞌaf, ma nnao ao monas, ma ankoa-muus. Ma in anteop napaap in aon neik fatu. Mes in aon nane naheel anneis. Ka nmuiꞌ fa atoni es he nfuutb ee, maski naka nfutu neik tain besi msat. Atoni sin nfuutb ee haef-haef mbi in aꞌnukun ma in haen neik tain besi, mes in nafeek naen tain besi nane, ma neok nafeek kabaꞌ naꞌko in haen. In maspeti nneis, tal antee ka nmuiꞌ fa atoni meseꞌ es nabeiꞌ he nhuku. Olas nane, Jesus sin nsaon naꞌko bero ꞌnaek, atoni leꞌ pah-tuaf amaunut antaam mbi in nekan nane napeen niit sin naꞌko ꞌloꞌo. Nalali te, in nanpoi naꞌko niut nateꞌ nane, oke te in naen annao ma nleuꞌ-tuuꞌ mbi Jesus In matan.

Olas Jesus nail naan atoni nane in huumn aa te, In naꞌuab am nak, “Hoi, pah-tuaf! Ho mpoi muꞌko atoni ii nai!” Nalail atoni nane in ankoa-muus naheel on mnak, “Huus! Ho he munsaꞌan kau! Au uhiin Ko, Ho leꞌ nane namneo Jesus, Uisneno Akuasat in Aan Mone. Au ꞌtoit Ko he Ho kaisa mususap kau!”
Ma Jesus ntoti mnak, “Ho kaanm ii, sikau?” Atoni naan natae mnak, “Au kaank ii Legion, fun hai leꞌ ii mimfau nneis, on leꞌ solalus puka ꞌnaek es!”
Nalali te, pah-tuaf in nmoeꞌ atoni nane in fefan henati ntoit Jesus, he kaisan nliuꞌ sin mpoin naꞌko bale nane.
Leꞌ ka nakloꞌo fa naꞌko bale nane, anmuiꞌ tuaf ampaon faifn aa puka ꞌnaek es. Faifn ini, on leꞌ he ntee tipuꞌ nifun nua. Sin namin amnahat mbi ꞌnuꞌaf abnapan.
Nalali te, pah-tuaf in ntoit Jesus mnak, “Mleul kai he mnao mtaam meu fafi nae kin.”

Nneen on nane te, Jesus anloem. Ma pah-tuafin nane, naen ampoi naꞌko atoni nane, ma nnaon ntaam neu fafin. Ma leꞌ fafi nifun nua nane, sin naen nasiit-bokan. Ma sin nsikaꞌ-noloꞌ antaam neu nifu naan, ma sin ok-okeꞌ leem anmaten mbi nane.

Olas atoni leꞌ apao fafi sin nail niit on nane te, sin ok-okeꞌ namtaun nmaten. Oke te, sin naenan nnaon natoon toob mbi kuan-kuan mbi nane. Ma atoni namfau mpoi neem, ma nnaon nail saaꞌn aa es anbool.

Sin neem naꞌeuk nok Jesus, ma sin napeen niit atoni leꞌ pah-tuaf amaunut antaam neu in nekan nane, ntook mbi nane. In neekn aa naleko ee, ma in natai nalail bael abtais ee. Niit on nane te, atoni sin ok-okeꞌ namtaun, fun sin nahiin nak, atoni sikau es leꞌ nabeiꞌ nliuꞌ napoin pah-tuaf naꞌko atoni nane, in maneꞌo-maneꞌo atoni lo-manenuꞌ.
Oke te, sin ok-okeꞌ mantonin mnak, “Hai miit meik hai maatm ini, atoni leꞌ pah-tuaf amaunut antaam neu in nekan, naleko ee. Ma hai miit faifn aa maneꞌo-maneꞌo leem anmaten.”
Ma toob naꞌko kuan-kuan antoit Jesus he nfeen nnao nasaitan sin bale.
Olas Jesus he nsae neu beor aa nanan, atoni leꞌ pah-tuaf amaunut antaam neu in nekan nane, neem antoit Jesus he in nok amsat.
Mes Jesus ka nloim fa. In naꞌuab mnak, “Naleko nneis, ho mnao mfain mutonan ho biak in ok-okeꞌ, saaꞌn aa leꞌ es Uisneno nmoeꞌ nalali neu ko. Ma mutoon mak Uisneno nneek niis ko.”

Nalali te, atoni nane nnao nfain, he nnao nafuun pah es anmuiꞌ koot boꞌes, es leꞌ sin nteek ee nak, ‘Dekapolis’. In anꞌeut nani leꞌ saaꞌ es Jesus anmoeꞌ nalali neu ne. Atoni ok-okeꞌ leꞌ nneen in uab nane, sin namkakan nmaten mnak, “Namneo, he!”
Usif Jesus namonib anfani ꞌnaef Jairo in aan feto. Ma nok bifeel amenat es leꞌ nlaab Usif Jesus in sabalu
Nalali te, Jesus sin nlaak anfanin neu nifu ꞌnaek in panin bian. Olas sin nsaon naꞌko beroꞌ, toob namfau neman ntool naan Ee.
Mbi nane, nmuiꞌ tuaf es, in kanan, ꞌnaef Jairo. In leꞌ nane, aꞌnakaf neu uim onen mbi kuan nane. Olas nane napeen niit Jesus, ma in nleuꞌ-tuuꞌ mbi In matan.
Ntoti mnak, “Koi, usiꞌ! Au aan feto in feꞌ naan toon boꞌes am nua, nameen he nmate. Ho maen oum feꞌ, he mulekoꞌ maan kau beꞌ.”
Ma Jesus natuin Jairo nnaon neu in ume. Mes olas sin nnaon, atoni namfau natuin sin, tal antee sin nnaon ka nalekon fa, fun toob namfau natuin bia-nam-bian.
Mbi toob amfaut sin soonk ini, anmuiꞌ bifeel es, es leꞌ in fun neneem ka nasnaas fa toon boꞌes am nua ben.
In loit ma in aꞌmaus ok-okeꞌ nalail sine, he mbaen amalot. Mes ka nmuiꞌ fa meseꞌ he naleko ee. Mes in menas nane, nfoe piut.

Bifeel nane, in nneen namfau matoom neu Jesus. On nane in nheoꞌk on natuin atoin in sin atnaank ini, he npaumaak nok Jesus in kotin. In naneꞌop mbi in nekan nanan nak, “Ile lamu au ubeiꞌ ꞌlaab ꞌaan In sabalu haen, au lof uleok.” Olas in ankais Jesus in sabalu, nok askeken, in naaꞌ asait leꞌ nane, nheu naan. In natniin in aon naleko nfini ee.
Pas olas nane, Jesus natniin anmuiꞌ maꞌtanin anpoin naꞌko In aon. In niik on kotin, ma niit toob namfau mbi In kotin. Oke te, In antoti mnak, “Sikau es ankais Au sabalu?”
In asium-noinaꞌ sin natae mnak, “Amaꞌ, Ho mail kuum! Atoni namfau on ii es anmabeꞌun. Nasaaꞌ Ho mtoit mak, ‘Sikau es ankais Au sabalu?!’ ”
Mes Jesus nail nateef, he naim leꞌ alelo sikau es ankasi.
Olas bifeel nane nneen Jesus ntoit on nane te, in namtau. Nalali te, in nleuꞌ-tuuꞌ mbi Jesus In matan, ma nmanaok mnak, “Amaꞌ. Au leꞌ es aꞌkais Ho sabalu.”
Ma Jesus natae le mnak, “Fun enaꞌ maneꞌo-maneꞌo mpalsai meu Kau, ho muleok mulali ee. Ma ho mnao mfain mok neek amlilat.”
Jesus feꞌ naꞌuab on nane te, nmuiꞌ amnemat naꞌko ꞌnaef Jairo in ume, natoon am nak, “Akoi! Liꞌaan feto nmate! Kaisa muhaeb mtein Kulu ii nai. Amaꞌ naleko nneis, kaisa mnao nai.”
Mes Jesus ka ntoe naan fa atoni nane in molok. Ma In naꞌuab neu ꞌnaef Jairo nak, “Ho kaisa mumtau, he! Mpalsai meubah Uisneno.”
Oke te, Jairo nok Jesus nnaon nasaitan In asium-noinaꞌ bian. Mes In nnao noba haa Pedru, Yakobus, ma nok Joao, sin nnaon piut.
Olas sin nteen ꞌnaef Jairo in ume, sin niit atoni namfau bataisiubꞌ in, ma sin nkambain naheel okan.
Jesus ntaam neu ume naan. Ma In antoit sin am nak, “Anasaaꞌ te hi mtaisibu meu kaet? Liꞌana ije, in ka nmatef. Mes ije, in antuup kuun.”

Sin nneen Jesus namolok on nane te, sin ok-okeꞌ maens Ee. Nalail, In nleul sin ok-okeꞌ mpoin. Ma In noꞌen liꞌana nane in enaf nok in amaf, ma nok in asium-noinaꞌ sin tuaf teun, he sin ok-okeꞌ ntaam neu liꞌana nane in keꞌan.
Ma Jesus nhuuk liꞌana nane in aꞌniman, oke te, In namolok neu ne neik sin lasi Aram mnak, “Talita kum!” (In aꞌnaonaꞌ nak, “Aan feto! Mfeen nai!”)

Suk naskeek, liꞌaan feto nane nfeen ma nnao. Nalali te, Jesus nleul in enaf nak, “Mfee liꞌana ii he naah nai!” Atoni ok-okeꞌ leꞌ aniit takaf saaꞌ leꞌ es anbool, sin namkakan. Mes Jesus naꞌekaꞌ maꞌtaniꞌ neu sin mnak, “Hi kaisa mitoon sikau-sikau mak Au umonib ufain ee be!”

footnotes.text: Sula Kninoꞌ mbi lasi Gregu (Yunani) nak, “Ama oum he mtao Ho ꞌnukum neu ne, henatiꞌ in neleko nfain, ma nmoin.” Mbi nae, “in ntoit he ntao in aꞌnukun” in aꞌnaonaꞌ nak, “mumnau ma mulekoꞌ maan ee”. Aan feto in toon nane, matuꞌi es lasi Gregu (Yunani) mbi elaꞌ 42.
